cues.zh: 电动汽车面临的一个问题是充电时间。
cues.en: One of the problems people have with electric cars is charging time.

cues.zh: 没错，现在的快速充电桩大约半小时就能把车充到 80%，
cues.en: Yes, modern fast chargers can get your car to 80% in about half an hour,

cues.en: but that's a long time compared to the three or four minutes

cues.en: so let's see if it works.

cues.en: - Nio has more than 2,100 stations operational in China,
